attributes.description: User activity across Snowflake query history, role grants, and login history. ACCOUNT_USAGE data may lag 45 minutes to 3 hours.

embeddableConfig.content:
This dashboard summarizes user activity across Snowflake query history, role grants, and login history. Review top users by query volume, bytes scanned by user and role, and a timeline of role grants and revokes. The off-hours login heatmap highlights logins outside typical business hours. The suspicious query table surfaces failed statements. Filter by user, outcome, and event action using the controls above.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/snowflake/overview)**
embeddableConfig.title: Overview

query.esql:
FROM logs-snowflake.login_history-*
| EVAL day_of_week = CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT("e", @timestamp), " ", DATE_FORMAT("EEE", @timestamp)),
       hour_of_day = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp)
| STATS logins = COUNT(*) BY day_of_week, hour_of_day
